pageDescription: My commissions: queue status, packages and request form.
tryLater: Please come back a little later.
fNickHint: It will be shown on your tracking page.
fEmailHint: Never published. It is only used to answer you.
fWantHint: Describe your idea: subject, style, intended use, size... A few sentences are enough.
fInspirationHint: An image or a page you like, for example https://example.org/image.
fNotify: E-mail me when my request moves forward
formPrivacy: Your e-mail address is never published. After sending, you get a private link to follow your request, no account needed. No payment is asked here.
thanks: Thank you, your request has been sent.
errNetwork: Sending failed. Check your connection and try again.
errNick: Write a first name or a nickname, for example Sam.
errEmail: Write your full address, for example sam@example.org.
errFormula: Choose a package from the list.
errWant: Describe your request in a few words, for example "a watercolour portrait of my cat".
errWantLinks: Put at most two links in this text: the inspiration link has its own field.
errInspiration: Write a full address, for example https://example.org/image, or leave the field empty.
errEmailTooMany: This address has already sent several requests today. Use your tracking link or try again tomorrow.
haveLink: Already sent a request? Open your private tracking link: you got it after sending, and by e-mail if you asked for it.
oops_invalid: Your request could not be sent: a field is empty or filled in wrongly. Go back, check the form and try again.
oops_rate: You sent many requests in a short time. Please try again a little later.
oops_closed: Commissions are not open right now. Look at the commissions page to see when they reopen.
oops_busy: Many requests are waiting. Please try again a little later.
trackUnknown: This tracking link does not exist or no longer exists. Check that you copied the whole address. If your request was finished long ago, it may have been erased.
trackKeep: This page is private: only this long link gives access to it. Keep it to follow your request and do not share it.
explain_new: it has not been read yet, you will get an answer soon.
explain_delivered: it is finished and delivered. Thank you!
explain_refused: this request could not be accepted.
aheadNone: You are next in the queue.
cancelText: You no longer want this request? It will be marked as cancelled.
forgetText: Your nickname, e-mail address and text will be erased for good, and this link will stop working.
forgetLater: To erase your request before the end of the commission, write to the site's contact.
mailConfirmBody:
Hello {nick},

Your commission request has been received. You can follow its progress at any time with this private link:
{url}

Keep this link to yourself: it is enough to see the state of your request. You only get it once; the next messages will only tell you that the state has changed.

You receive this message because this address was used in the commission form of {site}. If it was not you, ignore it: nothing will be done.
mailLinkBody:
Hello {nick},

Here is your new private link to follow your request:
{url}

The old link no longer works. Keep this one to yourself.

If this message is not meant for you, ignore it.
mailStatusBody:
Hello {nick},

The state of your request is now: {status}.

To see the details, open your private tracking link: it is in the first message you received.

You receive this message because this address was used in the commission form of {site}. If it was not you, ignore it.
mailTeamBody:
A new request arrived from {nick} (package: {formula}).

Open your commissions page to read it:
{url}

You get at most one message per hour, even if several requests arrive.
mailNotSet: E-mail sending is not set up on the site yet. It is not required: the people who order follow their request with their private link.
mailOff: E-mails to customers are switched off in this module's settings: they follow their request with their private link.
nearFull: You keep {n} requests out of {max} possible. Delete the oldest finished requests to be able to receive new ones.
seen_open: Your commissions are open: visitors can send a request.{free}
seen_full: Your commissions show "fully booked": the form is hidden.
seen_closed: Your commissions are closed: the form is hidden.
reopenPassed: The reopening date ({date}) has passed. Open your commissions whenever you want.
modeHelp_open: The form is shown. Free places are counted from your accepted and in-progress requests; when none is left, the page shows "fully booked" by itself.
modeHelp_full: The page shows "fully booked" and hides the form.
modeHelp_closed: The page shows "closed" and hides the form.
startSteps:
1. In the "Packages" tab, add what you offer (optional).  
2. Below, set the number of places.  
3. Click "Choose this state" next to "Open": your commissions page is then visible with its form.
fSlotsHelp: How many requests you take at the same time (accepted + in progress). Enter 0 for no limit.
fReopenHelp: Shown when commissions are full or closed, for example "Reopening planned on 12 March 2027".
fMessageHelp: One or two sentences, for example "I am finishing my Christmas requests first".
errSlots: Write a whole number between 0 and 99, for example 3.
errReopen: Pick a date in the calendar, for example 2027-03-12, or leave the field empty.
okQueue: Saved. Your visitors already see the new version.
emptyAll: No request yet. When someone sends one, it will appear here (and in the badge of the menu).
errGone: This request no longer exists. Go back to the list.
cardMissing: This person's card was deleted from Contacts: their e-mail address is no longer known. You can still change the state of the request.
cardUnavailable: Contacts is not answering right now: the card and the e-mail address cannot be read at the moment.
fClientNoteHelp: It is shown on their tracking page. Write nothing private: they will read it.
fNotifyThem: E-mail them about the change of state
fCreateCard: If I accept: also create their card in Contacts
fCreateCardHelp: Only once. Her e-mail address is then kept in Contacts and erased from the request.
fNoteHelp: Only the team sees them. They are never shown to the customer.
contactsText: Create this customer's card in Contacts (or find it if their address is already there). Their e-mail address will be kept in Contacts and no longer in the request.
linkText: Link lost? Create a new one: the old one stops working. It is sent to the person by e-mail if possible, otherwise it is shown here once.
linkConfirm: The old link will stop working. Continue?
deleteText: Deletes this request for good (nickname, text, tracking link). The card in Contacts is not deleted.
errStatus: Choose a state from the list.
okCardCreated: The card was created in Contacts.
okCardFound: The request is linked to their card in Contacts.
errCard_unavailable: Contacts is not answering: the card was not created. Try again later with "Add to Contacts".
errCard_too_many: The Contacts book is full: the card could not be created.
errCard_failed: The card could not be created in Contacts. Try again later with "Add to Contacts".
errMailFailed: The e-mail could not be sent (the request itself is up to date).
errMailLimit: The e-mail was not sent: too many messages to this address today.
overSlots: Careful: you are over your {slots} places.
okLinkMailed: The new link was e-mailed to them. The old one no longer works.
okLinkShown: New link (copy it now, it will not be shown again): {url} — the old one no longer works.
bookNote: Commission "{formula}" requested through the site form.
formulasHelp: Your packages are shown on the commissions page, in this order. Prices are indicative: the module never handles money.
formulasNone: You have no package yet. It is not required: without a package, the form offers no choice.
formulaDeleteConfirm: Delete this package? Requests already received keep its name.
formulasMax: You already have {n} packages, which is the maximum. Delete one to add another.
fFormulaPositionHelp: 1 = at the very top. Leave empty to put the package at the end.
errPosition: Write a number between 1 and {max}, for example 1.
formulaDeleteText: Requests already received keep the name of the package.
fFormulaIncludesHelp: One line per item: number of revisions, file format, usage rights...
fFormulaVisible: Show this package on the page
errFormulaName: Give the package a name, for example "Bust portrait".
csvHeader: Identifier|Received on|State|Last change|Nickname|E-mail|Package|Request|Inspiration link|Contacts card|Message to the customer|Private note
